text:
alex: Heads-up — nightly smallalloc benchmark on prod-staging showed steady RSS increase and OOM on one host. Dumping quick stats now.

infra-bot: Alert: host gpu-node-7 OOM at 2025-11-10T02:33:14Z (oom-killer invoked)

lydia: can you paste the pmap/smaps or `/proc/<pid>/smaps` snippet? also which allocator build?

alex: it's the runtime-jmalloc build from main (no recent allocator change). smaps snippet:
```
7f8b2d000000-7f8b2d020000 rw-p 00000000 00:00 0
Size:                2048 kB
Rss:                 1984 kB
...
```

alex: observed RSS grow ~20MB per minute for ~10min until OOM.

sre_john: sounds like a leak in KV cache or pinned KV pages. can you run `mallctl` or our je wrapper to dump arena stats? also `pagemap` can show anonymous vs file-backed pages.

maria: benchmark id? link to perf dashboard?

alex: benchmark id: bench/smallalloc/2025-11-09/rt-178. link: https://perf.redwood/bench/178

lydia: try `echo stats | nc /var/run/je-ctl 0` (we added file socket for stats). paste output

alex: pasted:
```
arenas: 8
allocated: 1.2G
active: 1.4G
muzzy: 0
metadata: 64M
extent_hooks: disabled
```

sre_john: interesting — active > allocated suggests fragmentation/retained extents. what's `mallctl` for purge? try `mallctl("arena.0.purge", NULL, NULL, NULL, 0)` but we have helper:
`/usr/local/bin/je-purge -a`

lydia: also check kernel compaction settings: `cat /proc/sys/vm/compact_memory` and `cat /proc/sys/vm/overcommit_memory`

alex: compact_memory=0, overcommit_memory=0

maria: can you run small reproducer with MALLOC_CONF toggles: `prof:true,lg_chunk:20,oversize_threshold:2` and see if RSS stabilizes.

alex: starting reproducer now, will push logs. assigning follow-ups: @lydia to run jeprof snapshot if we get another spike; @sre_john to schedule a short hoist for compaction tests.

lydia: ack. If reproducible, we should add a regression benchmark comparing arena active/retained.

alex: thanks — uploading heaptrace next.

deploy-bot: deploy #runtimes/staging succeeded for commit abc123

alex: uploaded heaptrace: https://artifacts/redwood/heaptrace/rt-178/trace1

maria: I'll triage after lunch. :coffee: 

sre_john: if it is retained growth, patch idea: periodically call `mallctl("arena.N.purge",...)` during low load or enable background purge. let's discuss in next standup.

alex: noted. will update thread with reproducer verdict by EOD.
